name: build 8B forward
command: cat /tmp/fwd8.c | ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cat > ~/bonsai2/asm/fwd8.c && cd ~/bonsai2/asm && LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -O2 -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -Dmain=pq2_main -c pq2_gemv.c -o fwd8_pq2.o 2>&1 | grep -i " error" | head -5; gcc -O2 -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -c fwd8.c -o fwd8.o 2>&1 | grep -i " error" | head -5; gcc -O2 -o fwd8 fwd8.o fwd8_pq2.o -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm 2>&1 | head -5 && echo BUILD_OK' 2>&1 | head -8
